title: COP31 electric power target sparks row over cutting fossil fuel use
paragraphs: A Türkiye-backed plan to increase electricity's share of energy consumption to 35 per cent by 2035 appears to be meeting resistance at this year's COP31 climate summit.
Australia, meanwhile, wants an agreement to double the number of households with rooftop solar.
Global leaders are set to arrive at Antalya, Türkiye in the coming days for talks.
